question: List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects they offered, including the department name, the school name, and the subject code description, for departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and are not the 'Political Science' department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;
column_mapping: {"departments": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "number of subjects offered": ["SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY"], "department name": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "school name": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME", "SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME"], "subject code description": ["SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC"], "degree granting": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING"], "Engineering school": ["SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME"], "Political Science": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME", "SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE"]}
domain_knowledge: ["\"Political Science\" is predicated by \"TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'\"", "\"Course 17\" is predicated by \"TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'\""]

expected.sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;
expected.column_mapping: {"departments": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "number of subjects offered": ["SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY"], "department name": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "school name": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME", "SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME"], "subject code description": ["SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC"], "degree granting": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING"], "Engineering school": ["SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME"], "Political Science": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME", "SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE"]}
